decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical DOS segment ordering declarations.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
It declares DOSCODE, DUM, DOSDATA, DOSDATALAST and DOSGRP, with conditional ROMDOS declarations; many selected DOS sources include it.
The saved selected kernel map reports DOSDATA size 136Ah (kernel-reference-comparison.json).
Selected DIR2 and FAT linked contributions match 1413 and 984 target bytes respectively (reviews 054 and 065); MSDATA data comparison still has 29 differing byte positions (review 086).
limitations: Matching component contributions and reference segment sizes do not establish final segment placement or complete target identity. ROMDOS and SHARE configurations are outside the selected build.
